Catalogue frame-quality scores were unavailable for the WISE frames from 2010 (cryogenic), 2010-2011 (post-cryogenic), so those frames were checked by their measured pixel noise instead.
3 of 429 SPHEREx spectrum points are left out (3 where the target saturates the detector).
The Gaia DR3 and CatWISE2020 lists were reused from the view built on 15 Nov 2026, because the catalogue services did not answer.
The spectrum is not classified because the target was not found in any WISE or SPHEREx image, so nothing confirms that the light measured at its predicted position is the target's.

The spectrum is not classified because a brighter catalogued source (W1 9.1) 13.0 arcsec away falls inside the area the SPHEREx photometry is fitted over; its light there is estimated at 3 times the target's own, or more.
The target was not detected in any frame.
